about.heading: Local services you can
about.lede: Ntizo connects people who need a service with people who know how to do it. Verified providers, the price up front, and payment only after the provider confirms the time.
about.missionTitle: Make hiring a service as simple and as safe as buying in a shop.
about.mission1: In Mozambique, finding a good plumber, a hairdresser or a tutor still depends on knowing someone who knows someone. The price is agreed over the phone, the time slips, and when it goes wrong there is nobody to turn to.
about.mission2: Ntizo exists to change that. Every provider is verified before they appear in results, every service shows its price, and every booking is on record from start to finish, from the time agreed to the payment.
about.howTitle: Three steps, and none of them is paying before you know it will happen.

search.title: Search and compare
search.body: Browse services by category and city, with the price, reviews from people who used them, and the verified badge.

book.title: Book the time
book.body: Pick the day and time on the provider's calendar and say where the service happens. The request goes to the provider to confirm.

pay.title: Pay after confirmation
pay.body: Only once the provider confirms the time do you get the payment prompt on your phone. Nothing is charged before that.

about.principlesTitle: Four rules that never change, whatever the service.

price.title: The price is the price.
price.body: The amount you see on the listing is the amount you pay. The platform's commission comes out of the provider's side, never yours.

verification.title: Verification before visibility.
verification.body: No provider appears in results without having sent an identity document and without a person at Ntizo having reviewed it.

payAfter.title: Pay only after the yes.
payAfter.body: The payment prompt arrives only after the provider confirms the time. If they do not confirm, or decline, there is nothing to charge.

local.title: Built for here, ready to grow.
local.body: M-Pesa, Portuguese, the cities we live in. And a platform designed to serve other countries when the time comes.

about.customersTitle: Find, book and pay in one place.
about.customersBody: No phone calls to learn the price, no waiting for a reply that never comes. Every booking has a time, an amount and a record.
about.providersTitle: Your calendar, your prices, your customers.
about.providersBody: Publish your services, set when you are available, and receive confirmed requests. Ntizo handles the calendar, the payment and getting you found.

careers.heading: Build Ntizo with us.
careers.lede: We are a small team building the infrastructure for local services in Mozambique. There are no open roles right now, but we read every application.
careers.building1: A marketplace where a customer finds, books and pays for a service with the same confidence as buying in a shop, and where a provider has a calendar, prices and payments without needing a company behind them.
careers.building2: We started with Mozambique, with M-Pesa and in Portuguese. The platform is designed from day one to serve other countries, other currencies and other languages.

how.title: We write before we build.
how.body: Every decision has a document with the why, so whoever comes next does not have to guess it.

how.title: We ship early and fix fast.
how.body: We would rather have a real version in a customer's hands than a perfect one in a presentation.

how.title: Whoever uses it comes first.
how.body: We talk to providers and customers before deciding for them.

careers.openingsBody: If you think we should be talking to you anyway, write to us. Tell us what you do well, what you have built, and why Ntizo. We reply to every one.
